**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/30 (Tue) 07:23
- [USER] User inquired about the chapter of the Texas Government Code that applies to public official surety bonds.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Chapter 174 of the Texas Government Code applies to public official surety bonds.
- [USER] User asked which section or sections of the Texas statutory code govern public official surety bonds.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Sections 174.001 to 174.005 of the Texas Government Code govern public official surety bonds.
- [USER] User inquired about the section or sections of the Texas statutory code that govern surety bonds for state officers and/or state employees.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Section 174.003 of the Texas Government Code governs surety bonds for state officers and/or state employees.
- [USER] User asked which section or sections of the Texas statutory code apply to state employee bonding requirements.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Section 174.003 of the Texas Government Code applies to state employee bonding requirements.
- [USER] User requested a list of any sections of the Texas statutory code that would govern or apply to "public official surety bonds" that cover state officers or state employees.
